name: smwmusic-touhou-eiyashou-imperishable-night-maiden-s-capriccio-dream-battle-stage-clear-mix
title: Touhou Eiyashou ~ Imperishable Night - Maiden's Capriccio ~ Dream Battle (Stage-Clear-Mix)
description:
Did a short arrangement of Reimu Hakurei's Theme, Maiden's Capriccio ~ Dream Battle (from Touhou 8 Eiyashou ~ Imperishable Night) as a "stage-clear-mix." Everybody loves their red protagonist who's in need of money and is very discriminative towards non-humans (which is not cool, kids).

Given it's length, it's much better fit for world clear jingle rather than the general stage clear jingle.



Note:
‎‎‎‎‎‎‎‎ㅤ♠ You will need to add ! to the line "default/0D SMW @14.brr" in Addmusic_sample_groups.txt for it to sound as intended in-game if you plan to use this as a global song.

Important:
‎‎‎‎‎‎‎‎There are also customizable pitches for this song that you can adjust in the song's txt file:
‎‎‎‎‎‎‎‎ㅤ1. D# Minor (Original Pitch) [turned on by default]
‎‎‎‎‎‎‎‎ㅤ2. E Minor (Custom Pitch)

There are also customizable options for enabling & disabling the goal tape sound that you can adjust in the song's txt file:
‎‎‎‎‎‎‎‎ㅤ1. Enables Goal SFX [turned on by default]
‎‎‎‎‎‎‎‎ㅤ2. Disables Goal SFX
